name: Norway: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, issuer or insurer are left empty, not invented.
Language is English (REK KULMU: Part II attachments other than consent forms and recruitment materials); no signature added at submission unless the document is an issued third-party record.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json; version and date match the CTIS structured fields; searchable, copyable PDF.

NO-K1.check: Uses the European Commission Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template v2.0 (or another format with all requested information), submitted in English.

The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section gives the not-applicable answer.

Names who identifies candidates, who gives information (a qualified member of the research group) and who obtains consent (not the treating physician where the dependency could compromise voluntariness).
Electronic consent is stated and its secure identity solution (BankID or another two-factor authentication) described.
Health-record screening: legal access of the staff and any requested exemption from confidentiality described.
Incapacitated adults: legally designated representative identified and verified, adapted participant information, dissent respected, capacity assessment and re-consent when capacity returns.
Minors: guardian consent as applicable, under-12, 12-15 and 16-17 pathways, own consent at 16, dissent respected, no incentives.
Impartial witness: trigger (cannot read or cannot write), independence, presence for the whole discussion, recorded name, role and relationship, remote verification.
Emergency: Article 35 conditions confirmed at first intervention, who decides, representative location, consent without undue delay, Article 35(3) right-to-object letter on refusal.
Every recruitment route matches the K2 items in the package.

NO-M1.check: One CV per principal investigator and Norwegian site; English accepted.
Shows clinical competence, previous clinical-trial experience, patient-care experience and GCP training.
Current ICH GCP E6(R3) competence documented, or confirmation that training will be completed before participant recruitment.
Only trial fields were filled by the assistant; personal details come from the investigator; no signature required.

NO-M2-DOI.check: One declaration per Norwegian principal investigator on the EU template or another separate document, in English.
Describes financial interests, institutional affiliations and other circumstances that could affect impartiality; completed by the investigator.
Interests that are relevant for participants are also disclosed in the Norwegian participant information.

NO-N1.check: One site-specific form per Norwegian site, in English.
Issued by the head of department, head of clinic or an equivalent institutional representative who is not the principal investigator; issuer and authority clear; no signature needed.
Project organisation and planned enrolment by site are presented here or in an attached enrolment plan or another submitted document.
Site fields completed by the site, not invented.

NO-O1.check: Valid certificate issued by the Norwegian Medicines Liability Association covering the trial.
Whether the sponsor has additional trial-specific insurance is stated, with its documentation where it exists.
Injury-coverage wording in every participant document matches the certificate and any additional insurance.
Submitted as issued; no added sponsor or investigator signature.

NO-P1.check: Describes all participant payments and reimbursement of expenses in English; states clearly when no payment is offered.
Reimbursement and compensation for lost earnings are distinguished from any incentive.
No incentives beyond expenses and lost earnings for minors, guardians, incapacitated adults or representatives.
Healthy volunteers: amount, schedule and pro rata payment after withdrawal; payment does not exert undue influence.
Amounts and conditions are identical to the participant documents.

NO-P2.check: Short English description of funding sources and what the funding covers.
Confirms that the intervention period is financially secured.
Overview of agreements between the sponsor and sites and of payment arrangements for sites or investigators; the underlying agreements are not uploaded.
Proof of fee payment is not placed here (Part I in Norway).

NO-R1.check: English statement on the EU template confirming GDPR compliance of data collection and handling.
States who issues the declaration and on whose behalf (sponsor or sponsor's representative).
Consistent with the privacy information in the participant documents (controllers, recipients, transfers, retention).

NO-S1.check: English document on the EU template; material, analyses, relationship to protocol endpoints, storage locations and periods, biobank details, cross-border movement and destruction or return plan.
Study-specific biobank linked to the trial identified when samples remain in Norway more than two months after collection.
Export and import: countries, purpose, storage period, residual material and destruction or return plan.

Future use declared as a separate purpose with separate broad consent; storage abroad beyond the trial states destination, purpose and safeguards; general biobank use with REK approval and its REK-approved consent.
Consistent with the protocol, the sample plan and every participant document.
